subject: Day 58: extra cuddles and rest
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day two of post-vaccine recovery, when most symptoms taper. Keep the day low-stimulation and let the established routines do the work while he finishes recovering.

Action items
- Keep today low-stimulation with extra skin-to-skin and rest; note that the oral rotavirus dose may still cause mild diarrhea or fussiness for another day. AAP immunization policy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Continue the AAP-recommended 400 IU/day vitamin D supplement, which is required for exclusively or predominantly breastfed infants regardless of how much daylight he gets. HealthyChildren vitamin D: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/healthy-living/nutrition/Pages/Vitamin-D-On-the-Double.aspx
- Track feeds and wet diapers today so you can confirm intake recovered to baseline before resuming normal activity tomorrow.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Lingering low-grade fussiness 24 to 72 hours post-vaccine and decreasing spit-up volume as the upper esophageal sphincter matures.
- [monitor] Asymmetric movement favoring one side, or a persistent head turn to one side suggesting torticollis; flag at the next visit.
- [call within 24h] Persistent vomiting unrelated to the vaccines, a noticeable drop in output, or a new feeding-refusal pattern.
- [call now] Rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher more than 72 hours after the shots, blue lips, or a seizure; for blue lips call 911 now!

Enrichment opportunities
- Read quietly from a familiar book to hold the routine steady while he recovers; daily reading from infancy builds the language base that drives later vocabulary. Reach Out and Read: https://reachoutandread.org/
- Offer soft serve-and-return coo turns only when he is alert and calm; back off if he turns away or frets, since over-stimulation is the wrong move today. Romeo et al. 2018: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29442613/
- Hold him upright on your chest for short stretches; the gentle head-steadying practice counts without a formal floor session.

Upcoming
- Day 57-72: still inside the post-vaccine window; expect symptoms to resolve by tomorrow.
- Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens near three months.
- Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- Looks at a toy for several seconds
  AAP window: day 35-60
  What to look for: Sustained visual attention — precedes reaching.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/looks-at-toy-several-seconds/complete

- Coos or makes sounds beyond crying
  AAP window: day 35-60
  What to look for: Vowel sounds like ooh, ahh. Pre-language vocalization. Distinct from fussing or hiccup sounds.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/coos-makes-sounds/complete

- Holds head up while on tummy
  AAP window: day 35-60
  What to look for: Sustained head lift of several seconds, not just a brief bob. Forearms may or may not be supporting yet.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/holds-head-up-tummy/complete

- Hands relax open most of the time
  AAP window: day 35-90
  What to look for: Newborn fists relax as the palmar grasp reflex fades. Predictor of voluntary grasp coming.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/hands-open-mostly/complete

- First social smile (responding to a face, not gas)
  AAP window: day 28-60
  What to look for: Smile in response to someone smiling or talking to them, not a reflexive gas smile. Hallmark social milestone.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/first-social-smile/complete
